about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1/shadow: edits of a test build's rewrite shadow (key equality, the defect's text) that a runtime/v1/shadow test must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1/shadow.

mutants.name: lf6c-shadow-float-by-go-equality
mutants.from: return math.Float64bits(x) == math.Float64bits(y) || x != x && y != y
mutants.rule: Shadow compares floats by key equality: a NaN equals a NaN.

mutants.name: lf6c-shadow-zero-sign
mutants.from: return math.Float64bits(x) == math.Float64bits(y) || x != x && y != y
mutants.rule: Shadow compares floats by their bits: -0 is not +0.
